button.description: No type. Defaults to submit when inside a form.
button.statusNote: Omitting the type defaults the button to type="submit".

button-submit.statusNote: Use inside a form for the primary action.

button-reset.statusNote: Rare. Confusing for users; consider omitting.

input-submit.description: Submits the parent form. Label comes from value.

input-button.statusNote: Avoid. Prefer a button element with type="button".

input-reset.description: Resets the parent form. Label comes from value.
input-reset.statusNote: Rare. Confusing for users; consider omitting.

input-image.description: An image used as a submit button. The image is the visible label and the alt attribute provides the accessible name.
input-image.statusNote: Submits the form and includes click coordinates in the payload.

input-checkbox-switch.description: A native checkbox with role="switch". The browser handles label-click forwarding, keyboard activation, and focus for free when linked to a sibling label element.
input-checkbox-switch.statusNote: Easiest accessible switch when the value is submitted as form data.

input-checkbox.statusNote: The native checkbox. Browsers handle keyboard activation, label-click forwarding, and accessible role for free.
